name: Ota (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ota ward emblem in purple: a winged device above a ring enclosing a white four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Ota, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 February 1952.

features.role: Ota ward emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a white four-pointed star
